notes.title: Pest Control Simulator – Live Stream at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
🐜 Pest Control Simulator – Live Stream at Steam Next Fest!

🚨 Join us for an exclusive live stream during Steam Next Fest! 🚨

We’re excited to announce that Pest Control Simulator, developed by Demonsoft Games and published by Blackburne Games Studio FZ LLC & Indienext, will be featured in Steam Next Fest from February 24 to March 1! 🎉

To celebrate, we’re hosting live streams throughout the event to showcase the game in action, answer your questions, and interact with our community!

💥 The infestation is spreading, and only YOU can stop it! Suit up, grab your extermination gear, and take on the swarms of pests in a highly immersive simulation. Can you handle the chaos?

💡 What Awaits You in the Live Stream & Demo?

🔥 Realistic Pest Extermination – Track, trap, and eliminate infestations before they take over.
🛠 Upgrade Your Gear – Use sprays, glue traps, electric zappers, and more!
🏡 Diverse Challenges – From cockroaches to rats, each pest requires a different strategy.
⚡ Fast-Paced, Strategic Gameplay – Stay sharp, plan your moves, and keep the infestation under control!

🎮 Join the live stream & play the FREE demo now to put your extermination skills to the test!

🚨 Don’t Miss Out!

📌 Live streams happening throughout Steam Next Fest—stay tuned!
📌 Join our Discord for exclusive events and updates!
📌 Follow our social media channels for the latest news!
📌 Wishlist & follow the game to stay up to date with all updates!

🔗 Wishlist & Play Now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3428940/Pest_Control_Simulator/]Steam Page[/url]
💬 Join our community: [url=https://discord.gg/7PKAh5g779]Discord[/url]
🌍 Learn more about Blackburne Games: [url=https://www.blackburnegames.com]Website[/url]

📢 Mark your calendars and prepare for the ultimate pest control challenge—see you at the live stream! 🎥

notes.title: Pest Control Simulator Steam Page is Live!
notes.notes:
🎉 Pest Control Simulator Steam Page is Live! 

We’re excited to announce that the Steam Page for  Pest Control Simulator is now officially live! 🚀

🔗 Check it out here: Pest Control Simulator on Steam
🔍 Wishlist now to stay up-to-date with all the latest news and updates.

Pest Control Simulator offers players a chance to tackle pest infestations in homes with a highly realistic simulation experience. From tiny ants to large rats, you'll use a variety of equipment and chemicals to keep your environment pest-free.

Literally..

What to Expect:

[list]
[*] Realistic Pest Control Experience
[*] Diverse Equipment and Strategies
[*] Chemicals and Upgrades
[*] Increasing Difficulty
[/list]

Your feedback means the world to us, so don’t forget to Wishlist and Follow us on Steam to stay updated on the latest news, development progress, and announcements.
